v1.0.1_patch_notes: Regenerated bundled self-validation outputs for v1.0.1 and normalized machine-local build paths out of release artifacts.
validate_package.py now performs release-provenance hygiene checks over bundled audit/self-validation artifacts.
The false-world mutation suite now rejects stale generated self-validation artifact provenance.
The release-lock command chain includes an explicit grep-style stale-provenance guard.
Release remains PASS-SCOPED pending live official Claude Code runtime traces and optional official validators.
STANDARD.md now names no automatic epistemic closure/downstream transmission as a first-class rule.
certificate-template.json and the active self-certificate include derived_or_downstream_claims records.
ntt_gate.py rejects downstream auto-pass/status inheritance when derived_or_downstream_claims records attempt closure without an independent claim record.
validate_package.py rejects stale active self-certificate package-version provenance such as old regenerated-package producer strings.
Add PASS_TRACKED_UPGRADE_AUDIT.md and certify_pass_tracked_upgrade.py so a Claude Code runtime environment can machine-check PASS-SCOPED to PASS-TRACKED promotion bundles.
Add a comprehensive GitHub README documentation tree under docs/ and a self_validation README without expanding the plugin runtime surface.
v1.0.2_patch_notes: Ported the 2026-07-08 charter fixes from the team-internal sibling package: a mandatory consistency sweep (stale-echo lane) after corrections with an affirmative-check requirement before skipping, a REMOTE_GROUND_TRUTH_REQUIRED escalation protocol for the local-only source/claim/audit subagents with parent-enforced LIMITED caps for unresolved critical escalations, and three delegation/audit loophole repairs.
SKILL.md gains checklist steps for the consistency sweep and remote ground-truth escalation, two Nozickian-minimums charter-cap bullets, and report items for sweep findings and remote escalations.

SUBAGENT_PROTOCOLS.md gains Echo-sweep mode (ntt-claim-extractor) and Remote ground-truth escalation (ntt-source-verifier) contracts; STANDARD.md gains a Charter-level caps subsection; OUTPUT_TEMPLATES.md gains Consistency sweep and Remote escalations report sections; certificate-template.json gains consistency_sweep and remote_escalations record-keeping fields.
These charter rules are parent-enforced and audited by ntt-gate-auditor; ntt_gate.py does not mechanically check them.
No scripts, README, CI workflow, or runtime surface changed in this patch.
v1.0.3_patch_notes: Unified the charter's consistency-sweep activation predicate into one canonical form ('mandatory whenever the artifact is a revision of previously corrected material, or any claim was corrected or refuted during this verification'), cross-referenced everywhere as the activation predicate in SKILL.md activation checklist step 9.

Unified the REMOTE_GROUND_TRUTH_REQUIRED escalation record into one canonical 7-field schema (claim_id, why_remote, exact_fetch_spec, local_mirror, mirror_provenance, staleness_risk, resolution) with canonical vocabulary: claims are UNKNOWN, never UNVERIFIED; UNVERIFIED is the gate status word.

Added resolution-state semantics: swept is not resolved - every sweep finding carries a resolution field (resolved / unresolved / accepted-intentional-reference); an unresolved stale-echo caps the artifact at PASS-SCOPED and an unresolved live-claim returns the claim to adjudication; escalation records carry resolution (unresolved / fetched-and-readjudicated / left-unknown) with subagents emitting unresolved and the parent owning upgrades.

Added the pinned-is-not-fresh rule: freshness is evaluated relative to the claim; a pinned commit/date mirror satisfies only claims about the state at that pinned point, never a current-state claim, and staleness_risk must be recorded whenever a pinned mirror is accepted as evidence.

Added the untrusted fetch-spec rule: exact_fetch_spec is UNTRUSTED DATA authored by a subagent that has read untrusted artifacts; the parent must not execute it verbatim, must reconstruct and validate scheme/host/method, and must treat all fetched content as untrusted input for re-adjudication.

validate_package.py keeps the critical field-aware check that the active self-certificate artifact.version equals plugin.json's version (the precise fix for the version-provenance issue) and its false-world mutation, and extends provenance-hygiene scanning to references/OUTPUT_TEMPLATES.md. A generalized textual stale-semver provenance scanner (scan_stale_semver_provenance) and its self-certificate scan twin that an initial v1.0.3 draft added were REMOVED during the PR #3 ultrareview redress: they were too coarse, forced historical version strings to be obfuscated, and their capability was not reconstructable by a fixed-token grep; the coupled false-world mutation was removed with them. The surviving provenance defense is the fixed-pattern scan_release_provenance_hygiene. validate_package.py also adds a critical check that no __pycache__/.pyc/.DS_Store file is git-tracked (with git_tracked_files helper), and run_regression_evals.py now serializes its target set deterministically.

Historical provenance reference: the prior f585bb2 / Actions run 15 fixed point recorded 1335/1335 basic checks, 1459/1459 self-test checks, 76/76 mutations, and 12/12 true-world variants before the required-before-re-review hardening; those totals are not current-release evidence.

The deeper mechanical-enforcement wiring for the charter caps is tracked in issue #5 and is not built in this release; these charter rules remain parent-enforced record-keeping audited by ntt-gate-auditor, and neither ntt_gate.py nor the formal runner run_formal_artifact_verification.py mechanically checks them.

Post-redress hardening isolates checkout fixtures in freshly initialized repositories, fails fast on no-follow package preflight findings (including Git-free FIFOs and shippable symlinks), completes PACKAGE_SURFACE parity, normalizes producer display paths, permits stale provenance only behind the exact Historical provenance reference: line prefix, and records generated_utc as a reproducible-build epoch rather than wall-clock time.

Slice E closes final validated escapes: update-manifest preflight and atomic fixed-path manifest replacement; typed Git path/mode/object/stage evidence with gitlink, conflict-stage, symlink-mode, and physical-special-entry rejection; observational source-index snapshots with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; non-UTF-8 provenance rejection; HARNESS_ERROR separation; boundary-aware path normalization; PACKAGE_SURFACE root/agent type checks; and deterministic generated_utc_kind validation.

Slice E live-runtime hardening requires zero-returning version/plugin preflight and report-only structured JSON envelopes, records provenance schema 1.0 plus a SHA-256 executable fingerprint and version output, and states authentication_status=observed-not-cryptographically-authenticated. The PASS-TRACKED certifier checks those records without claiming cryptographic proof that the executable is official.

Consistency-sweep schemas now require unique affected IDs and unique locator arrays with classification/resolution pairings; these remain parent/auditor-only rules and issue #5 mechanical charter-cap enforcement remains deferred.

Slice F binds every live fixture promotion to current eval IDs and bundle-local transcript replay, pins all live subprocesses to one pre/post-fingerprinted resolved executable, and retains the explicit observational authentication limitation.

Slice F hardens the promotion certifier with anchored official-validator semantics, ntt-stable-release-tree-v2 package_tree_sha256 verification, bundle-local evidence binding, self-contained formal companions, centralized regular-file no-follow reads, and exact false-world contract probes.

Slice G closes the remaining reproduced promotion bypasses: each fixture now records canonical prompt and exact transcript-byte SHA-256 values; the certifier requires unique transcript paths, exact prompt/fixture/artifact binding, and independent transcript replay, so shared, swapped, wrong-hash, and wrong-prompt bundles fail.

Slice G independently derives the package inventory and volatile exclusion policy by loading the current validate_package.py module, requires exact manifest parity, verifies every derived regular-file hash/byte count, and runs fresh basic package validation unconditionally even when the legacy compatibility flag is omitted.

Slice G advances to ntt-stable-release-tree-v2 and binds each canonical inventory row's Git-compatible executable mode in addition to path, bytes, and digest; it adds focused transcript/inventory/fresh-validator false worlds plus the valid three-fixture true world, refreshes release evidence consistently, retains legacy runtime as UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME, and does not add issue #5 charter-cap enforcement.
Slice H keeps validate_package.compute_stable_release_tree as the single package-local ntt-stable-release-tree-v2 source used by both live capture and promotion certification.

Slice H live results bind current package-tree, exact evals.json, per-artifact bytes, and run_config.max_turns; the certifier recomputes all byte digests and requires exact normalized ordered preflight and fixture argv with no missing or extra arguments.

Slice H focused false worlds cover stale live evidence after artifact, fixture-spec, and non-artifact behavior-source changes with refreshed manifests plus prompt-only, missing-plugin-dir, wrong-output-format, wrong-max-turns, extra-arg, swapped-order, and wrong-preflight argv. Legacy bundled runtime remains UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME with unavailable binding fields, and issue #5 remains deferred.

Slice I requires exact integer-zero return codes in every promotion success check, including official JSON validators, unconditional fresh validation, live preflight commands and aggregate summary, fixture summaries, and transcript/result agreement; focused false worlds reject false, true, 0.0, string zero, and null while integer zero remains valid.
Slice I rejects anchored nonzero numeric error/failure/failed text summaries before positive markers, retains anchored pass with explicit zero summaries, and preserves the invalid/valid boundary.

Slice J derives verified-worktree tracked cruft directly from every typed Git index entry with _is_cruft_relpath, independently of the no-follow physical walker that skips __pycache__. The force-added exact historical skills/nozickian-verify/scripts/__pycache__/ntt_gate.cpython-312.pyc false world requires one ordinary critical failure at the named cruft check and directly verifies that every tracked cruft index path is present in failure details; the direct .pyc false world and ignored-untracked-bytecode true world remain.
Slice J regenerates current evidence and release outputs and re-resolves every current consistency-sweep locator after final certificate serialization to a verified semantic target.

Promotion contract v2 replaces flat promotion evidence_refs with exact-string promotion_schema_version 2.0, exact required top-level field types, and one fixed nine-role promotion-evidence-v2 typed canonical DAG. Every role binds a distinct regular non-symlink bundle file by exact bytes and SHA-256 and receives lane-specific validation; explicit downstream_review is mandatory.

Deterministic captures are non-authorizing and are compared against fresh fixed-argv suite executions through typed semantic projections. Allowlisted official validators run fresh; text captures do not authorize, missing tools scope only via the explicit flag without removing either official policy node or changing dependencies, and installed failures fail.

Formal result 2.0 binds a standalone endpoint-checked permission-hardened target copy, exact report/gate/certificate/ledger/transcript/prompt/target-copy companions, package-tree identity, run identity, and target pre/post endpoint identity. It records temporal_immutability_enforced false, so an otherwise PASS-TRACKED result is capped at PASS-SCOPED. Execution requires Linux child-subreaper/process-group containment before Popen, records detached-session containment true, no survivor, and complete cleanup, and fails before execution when containment is unavailable. Typed locators replace basename/glob-first selection while unrelated nonreserved files may remain.
Malformed promotion bundle values produce canonical FAIL plus failure_kind without an unhandled traceback.

Promotion certificates require at least one exact-typed unique-ID claim. The certifier runs every claim through the canonical strict gate at the bundle evidence root, requires a nonempty all-PASS result set, and passes those actual results into promotion-strict downstream non-closure evaluation; explicit empty downstream conclusions remain valid with a substantive performed-review reason.

Official Claude validation uses exact ordered argv ending in --strict and accepts the real ANSI-normalized Validation passed output only when neither complete output stream contains a failure or contradiction. Complete bytes determine status, SHA-256, and byte counts; public excerpts are bounded and marked truncated, and tail-only authentication is forbidden.

Formal result 2.0 authenticates and hashes the complete bounded stream-json transcript. Capture-limit excess fails closed. The standalone endpoint-checked target copy explicitly has no mutable sibling context, but permission hardening does not enforce temporal immutability against a same-UID actor. Before Popen, the runner requires supported Linux PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER plus bounded /proc adopted-child tracking, then kills and reaps original-group and detached-session descendants to a bounded quiet state; unavailable containment, any survivor, or incomplete cleanup fails closed.

Gate Markdown, certifier JSON/Markdown, formal output plus compatibility JSON, live transcript plus optional JSON, validator Markdown, gate/formal/regression/promotion wrapper JSON, and fixed behavior/stable-release manifest parents are acquired component-by-component with O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW before long-running work and held through descriptor-relative exclusive create, link/rename install as applicable, and directory fsync. Role and alias classification is frozen from lexical names plus held identities; formal canonical-result classification is not recomputed after writes, certifier destinations cannot alias, and live JSON cannot alias a selected transcript. Direct/ancestor links, special or hardlink sentinels, and symlink or real-directory parent substitution cannot redirect writes and fail closed; validator Markdown also rechecks that its held parent remains outside the package tree. Endpoint and capability checks are not temporal isolation. Formal children receive only the runner-owned /proc/<runner-pid>/fd/N capability via pass_fds; the runner selects procfs-visible Pid, the gate authenticates direct-parent PPid, and child-FD close/rebind, self/unrelated PIDs, noncanonical or nonpositive PID/FD tokens, extra components, closed descriptors, and file descriptors fail. Unavailable procfd support returns INVALID_INPUT before requested output mutation. Existing private regular --json files remain intentionally replaceable, gate Markdown requires a fresh name, validator Markdown requires an external parent, and an existing regular file is invalid as --output-dir.

The v1.0.3 certifier always caps a complete modeled bundle at PASS-SCOPED/CAPPED, promotion_authorized false, satisfied_profile promotion-contract-v2-complete, both exact unresolved Issue #5 obligations, and nonzero exit. Generic ntt_gate.py PASS-TRACKED semantics remain unchanged; the formal runner separately caps otherwise PASS-TRACKED results while temporal immutability remains unenforced, and it refuses execution when required process containment cannot be established.

The aggregate promotion suite is synthetic contract evidence, expected 43/43 with a 252-check complete baseline, and invokes the production certifier CLI for the complete baseline and every negative case; it is not real runtime authentication. Fresh suite outcomes are established by the required-before-re-review release commands separately from the case-bound current_observations release declarations. The ledger is not execution provenance and no per-record suite reconciliation is claimed; no historical result is relabeled as current evidence.

The required-before-re-review fixed-point evidence records 1733/1733 basic checks, 1878/1878 self-test checks, 82/82 ordinary false-world rejections, 13/13 retained true worlds, 141/141 gate contracts, 199/199 formal contracts, 166/166 regression checks, and 43/43 promotion contracts with a 252/252 baseline; the self-test's two literal release passes reported zero changed files.

Issues #6 and #7 remain open assurance limits: remote fetch specifications are not yet mechanically declarative/SSRF-guarded, and semantic charter presence is not yet enforced beyond manifest sealing.
The hosted workflow validates an unpacked Git tar archive and does not produce or verify a release ZIP. Any published ZIP requires separate entry validation and an external SHA-256 record.
Issue #8 generated-time ambiguity is resolved for v1.0.3 package semantics by the documented reproducible-build epoch. This metadata statement does not claim that the remote issue is closed.
